description: OCD-style overdrive draft from S002-verified topology + user node connections. Supply 8-18V DC center-negative, 9V nominal test. Clip wiring confirmed from S002 image. Op-amp feedback wiring assumed. Not a verified Fulltone netlist. Do not fabricate.

assumptions: 9V nominal test; design range 8-18V DC center-negative per C022.
Op-amp feedback networks (X1/X3) are standard Vref-biased assumptions from component values; not pin-verified against S002 schematic.
R2 to GND per S002-confirmed text and schematic image (C026) — not VREF. R6 biases op-amp non-inverting input to VREF.
X2 modeled as 500k (50% of 1M). S002 states 'gain pot (1M)' — mapping/wiring to X2 assumed.
X5 modeled as 50% of 100k placeholder — volume value NOT found in retrieved S002 text; unverified.
M1/M2 exact part numbers unknown; APPROX_2N7000 simulation-only, unverified. D1=APPROX_1N34A per S002-confirmed 1N34A Ge clipping diode (C027). APPROX sim-only, Ge variability applies.

Tone/HP-LP values CONFIRMED from S002 schematic image: X4=10k pot (article text), C11=47nF, R14=22k, R15=33k. Switch1 wiring assumed.
Provenance: S002 article text + schematic images (webfetch 2026-11-10) + user-provided node connections from schematic image (2026-11-09). Images in circuit/sources/s002-images/.

requirements.text: Two TL082 gain stages + MOSFET/diode nonlinear stage (user-reported connections)
Adjustable gain and volume (simplified in sim)

architecture.summary: Vref-biased single-supply 9V: input bias -> X1 gain -> R9/R10/R12/C7/M1/M2/D1 clip network (to Vref) -> X3 gain/filter -> tone (X4 10k pot + C11 to ground) -> HP/LP (Switch1 parallels R14/R15) -> volume -> OUT.

decisions.decision: 8-18V DC center-negative per C022; 9V nominal test condition
decisions.rationale: Project requires 8-18V range (C022); S002 confirms circuit works 9V to 18V; 9V used as nominal test point

decisions.decision: Implement user-reported M1/M2/D1/R9/R10/R12/C7 connections from schematic image (S002-based)
X2 gain pot 1M per S002 retrieved text (mapping to X2 assumed); X5 volume 100k placeholder (not found in retrieved S002 text); X4/Switch1 omitted for sim
alternatives: ask user for exact pot values/wiring
decisions.rationale: user asked to find likely values from academic/available sources; S002 states 'gain pot (1M)' and '10k pot X4'; volume not explicit in retrieval

decisions.decision: M1/M2 upgraded to sourced 2N7002 model (Fairchild/Bordodynov, KiCad Spice Library mirror). D1 remains APPROX_1N34A (no manufacturer SPICE model for Ge). TL082.301 (TI, ±15V characterized, extrapolative at 8-18V single supply). 2N7002 is SOT-23 package; 2N7000 is TO-92 — same die, different package/pinout. Pinout must be verified for chosen package.
alternatives: BSS138 (sourced NMOS model in catalog, different Vgs threshold)
decisions.rationale: 2N7002 sourced model available from KiCad Spice Library; 2N7000 has no catalog entry. Electrical characteristics are nearly identical (same die). Package/pinout differs and must be verified.
sources: Fairchild 2N7002 model (Bordodynov library, KiCad Spice Library mirror)

decisions.decision: Reverted: R2 to GND per S002-confirmed text (1M input reference to ground). R6 biases op-amp non-inverting input to VREF. D1=APPROX_1N34A per S002-confirmed 1N34A Ge clipping diode.
alternatives: keep R2 to VREF (provisional sim fix, conflicts with S002)
verify S002 image for pin-level confirmation
decisions.rationale: S002 text explicitly states R2 connects input cap C1 to GROUND as voltage reference (C026). Previous VREF move was a provisional sim bias fix and is now removed.

decisions.decision: Implement S002-confirmed tone/HP-LP network: X4=10k tone pot, C11 tone cap to ground, Switch1 (HP/LP) parallels R14/R15. R14=22k/R15=33k image-read from S002 schematic (verify); C11=47n placeholder.
alternatives: ask user for exact tone/HP-LP values/wiring
decisions.rationale: S002 text confirms X4=10k pot, C11 cap to ground, HP/LP parallels R14/R15 (C028). Clip wiring confirmed from S002 schematic image matches user-reported wiring; commenter-reported alternate wiring does not match image.
